title.en: An Act Declaring as Bonus the three Months Advance Pay Authorized in Administrative Order Numbered One Hundred Sixty-Seven, Dated December Twelve, Nineteen Hundred and Forty-One, of the President of the Philippines, and in Commonwealth Act Numbered Six Hundred Seventy-Six.

text.en:
The three months advance pay given, pursuant to Administrative Order Numbered One hundred
sixty-seven, dated December twelve, nineteen hundred and forty-one, of the President of the Philippines, and
Commonwealth Act Numbered Six hundred seventy-six, to officials, employees and laborers of the
Commonwealth Government, including those of provincial, city and municipal governments, and of
government owned or controlled corporations, is hereby declared as bonus, and the officials, employees and
laborers who received such pay shall not be required to reimburse the same.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, September 26, 1945.
